1879064197.Skill_Desc: Significantly heals Morale of an ally or yourself.

1879096837.Skill_Desc: When you enter Scribe Stance, you change your Mentor skills into Scribe Manual skills, allowing you to create manuals to teach instruments. Scribing manuals is much more taxing than teaching in person, requires a Blank Mentor Manual, and will apply a 10 day cooldown to all Mentor skills.

1879097861.Skill_Desc: As an Uruk you are adept at whipping those lesser beasts in Sauron's army back into shape.\n\nHeals your target and anyone in their war-band in close proximity to your target.

1879172997.Skill_Desc: Removes tier 3 dread obtained from defeat.

1879198341.Skill_Desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879206149.Skill_Desc: A powerful sword strike that does incredible damage to an enemy of Gondor, but cannot be used often.

1879212933.Skill_Desc:
Daze the enemy briefly, waking the foe when damage is dealt.

Does not break Stealth.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Daze replaced with a debuff that reduces damage against dismounted players.</rgb>

1879214597.Skill_Desc: A targeted strike that is very difficult to avoid and deals potent damage for a long time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879218437.Skill_Desc: A song that can make an enemy, and up to two other enemies within ten metres of the first, become drowsy and not detect players until they are much closer than normal. This does not work against monsters already engaged in combat.

1879251717.Skill_Desc: Boromir carries a horn with which he can summon aid during times of greatest need.

1879260037.Skill_Desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

1879263621.Skill_Desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.

1879276549.Skill_Desc: Your sharp bark catches your enemies by surprise, opening up opportunities to strike.

1879291397.Skill_Desc: A melee attack that increases healing effects on yourself for a short time.\n\nRestores Morale of the Fellowship.

1879316485.Skill_Desc: Summons a shadow grim to your side. It is helpful during bright days.
1879316485.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter in the Yule Festival.

1879329157.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Minas Tirith.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879334661.Skill_Desc: Held within the grip of the Black Shadow, Merry must resist its dark pull if he is to survive.

1879342469.Skill_Desc: A steed evoking the beauty of the moth.
1879342469.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Spring Festival for Mithril Coins.

1879358085.Skill_Desc: A damaging sword strike to a single enemy.

1879389957.Skill_Desc: A simple punch often does the trick.

1879394565.Skill_Desc: A noble fallow deer dressed for the season.

1879405445.Skill_Desc: Summons a silly goose to keep you company.
1879405445.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Spring Festival.

1879442565.Skill_Desc: Blow the horn to summon Kyrstig to your side.

1879457541.Skill_Desc: A series of impossibly fast attacks strike your opponents.\n\nThis skill will consume any War Cry, Brink of Victory, Surety of Death, or Desolation damage over time effects on your targets, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

1879458181.Skill_Desc: Summons an adorable sickle-fly to accompany you on your journeys.
1879458181.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Spring Festival.

1879458693.Skill_Desc: You are the first line of defence, facing down enemies directly and without fear.\n\nWhile active, you will build stacks of 'At the Fore' when hit by enemies.

1879466245.Skill_Desc: Navigate to Trader's Wharf with nearby fellows.

1879479301.Skill_Desc: Summons a sublime pet to accompany you on your travels.
1879479301.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Acquired from the Sublime Patron's Enhanced and Luxuriant Coffers.

1879508741.Skill_Desc: Navigate to Zajâna in Kighân in Mûr Ghala with nearby fellows.
